STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits on a white square plate with a raised rim band and a flat centre. No deep inner wall is visible, so this is a flat plate (square).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Square plates are typically 20-30 cm. The plate looks medium-sized relative to the food, so I estimate about 24 cm.
b) Reference object: no fork or other standard-size object is clearly visible at the plate edge to count lengths across. The brussels sprouts are roughly 3-4 cm across, and the plate spans about 6-7 sprout widths in the frame, which gives about 22-25 cm. Taking both cues together, width is about 24 cm.

STEP 3 - Food items (plate footprint and thickness):
- Square area: 24 x 24 = 576 cm². The food covers roughly 60% of the plate, so footprint ≈ 345 cm².
- Brussels sprouts (roasted): about 6-7 halves/whole sprouts, roughly 3 cm across. Footprint about 25% of the total food area, average thickness about 2 cm (one sprout high, mounded), so volume ≈ 85 cm³. Cooked density ~0.6 g/ml gives ~50 g. Count-based estimate: 7 sprouts x ~15 g = ~100 g. I use ~90 g.
- Caesar-style salad greens with dressing and shaved cheese (romaine, dressing, parmesan): covers about 30% of food area, mounded about 2.5 cm average. Volume ≈ 345 x 0.3 x 2.5 ≈ 260 cm³; density of dressed leafy greens ~0.6 g/ml gives ~155 g. Adding shaved parmesan and dressing, I estimate ~150 g total.
- Rice/grain base with sauce (orange-brown, likely rice with tomato or sauce), plus chicken pieces and zucchini/yellow squash: covers about 35% of the food area, average thickness ~1.5 cm. Volume ≈ 345 x 0.35 x 1.5 ≈ 180 cm³. Grains density 0.8 g/ml gives ~145 g.
- Chicken pieces (visible in the salad and rice area): about 60 g.
- Yellow squash/zucchini pieces: about 50 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: The rice base sits under the squash and sprouts, which I already counted. No other large hidden layer is evident. Total ≈ 90 + 150 + 145 + 60 + 50 = 495 g.

STEP 5 - Energy values (as served, cooked):
- Brussels sprouts, roasted with oil: ~70 kcal/100 g
- Caesar salad with dressing and parmesan: ~190 kcal/100 g
- Cooked rice with sauce: ~150 kcal/100 g
- Chicken, cooked: ~180 kcal/100 g
- Yellow squash, cooked: ~25 kcal/100 g

Estimated total: about 90 x 0.70 + 150 x 1.90 + 145 x 1.50 + 60 x 1.80 + 50 x 0.25 ≈ 63 + 285 + 218 + 108 + 13 ≈ 687 kcal.
